title: Chili con carne with lean beef
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion, garlic, pepper and chilli and sweat them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and fry until crumbly, then briefly toast the spices and tomato purée.
Add the tomatoes and rinsed beans, season with salt and simmer covered for 25–30 minutes.
Serve with rice and a dollop of yoghurt.
